sections.title: AI Training Courses Ireland
sections.subtitle: Practical, instructor-led AI courses in Dublin, Cork, Limerick and live online. Learn to use AI tools confidently, safely and well.

sections.title: About our AI courses
content: Generative AI tools such as ChatGPT and Microsoft Copilot can draft documents, summarise reports and meetings, analyse data and answer questions in plain language. Used well, they save time on everyday tasks and help teams produce better work in almost every role.

Our instructor-led courses give you the practical skills to use these tools confidently and responsibly. You will learn how to write clear requests, check AI output for accuracy, protect sensitive information and build AI into your daily work. For managers, we also cover where AI adds real value, how to assess the risks and how to plan a successful rollout. No technical background is needed.
